Klasse MovementHandler

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.client.handlers.MovementHandler
public class MovementHandler extends Object
Handles movement update messages from the server on the client side. Converts server grid coordinates to pixel positions and manages ball rendering.

    • setGamePane

      public void setGamePane(javafx.scene.layout.Pane pane)
      Sets the game pane where balls are rendered. Clears any existing ball renders.

    • onMoveUpdate

      public void onMoveUpdate(MessageParser.Message message)
      Handles a movement update from the server. Parses the payload containing player positions in "id:x,y;id:x,y;..." format, converts grid coordinates to pixel coordinates, and updates or creates ball renders.
      Parameter:
      message - the parsed movement update message
